decisions: Implemented full multi-project candidate fetching instead of documenting a staged limitation.
Accepted tracker.projects.<project_key>.slug as the canonical multi-project Linear slugId field and retained project_slug as a per-project alias plus legacy top-level fallback.
Normalized repository lists to comma-separated SYMP_PROJECT_REPOSITORY values because the existing workflow hook splits that env var on commas.
Restored built-in mimocode/codex schema defaults because existing config tests and the workflow prompt require them when agents are omitted.
